description.value:
For the duration, your footwork keeps you clear of retaliation — you don't provoke opportunity attacks while moving.

Once before the power ends, you may grant yourself advantage on a single weapon attack roll on your turn; that attack deals an extra 1d8 force damage if it connects. Whether the attack hits or misses, your walking speed jumps by 30 feet until that turn ends.

system.source: PHB Ch.14 Casting — Universal Powers, Level 1
